{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Soldier's Claymore Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Soldier's Claymore Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Soldier's Claymore Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Soldier's Claymore Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= 20 |durability= 25 |comp= {{Infobox Game Blocks |TotK= [[Soldier's Claymore✨]] }} |sample= |theme= }} '''Soldier's Claymores''' are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Soldier's Claymore|Soldier's Claymores|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 20 |durability = 25 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Soldier's Claymore}} Soldier's Claymores are two-handed swords that were designed to be used in combat. They are heavy, and therefore difficult to use, but have a decent quality and durability. They are commonly used by [[Enemy|Enemies]] in [[Hyrule Field]] and the [[Faron Grasslands]], though they can also be found abandoned. Scanning the following [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]] have a chance to drop a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Soldier's Claymore * {{SSB}} Series [[Young Link]] amiibo * {{SSB|-}} Series [[Ganondorf]] amiibo * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{OoT}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series Young Link ({{MM}}) amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Daruk]] amiibo Due to being made of metal, Soldier's Claymores will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], and they will sink if dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. If they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], they will not burn like a wooden [[Weapon]] would. Soldier's Claymores belong to the [[Soldier's Gear]] equipment archetype, which were designed for the soldiers of [[Hyrule Kingdom]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_002" |Life = 25 |Power = 20 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 17 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 3 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 18 |BuyingPrice = 75 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Two-Handed Weapon |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Soldier's Claymore}} {{Stub|TotK}} Soldier's Claymores reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Name citation * Model and icon in the infobox * Where the Item is found * How much the Item costs, how much it can be sold for * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} An ancient version of the Soldier's Claymore appears as a [[Two-Handed Weapon]].
